description: List bookable/assignable resources — meeting rooms, desks, hot desks, private offices — with capacity, price, rate, floor and amenities. Resource _ids are needed by officernd_create_booking. OfficeRnD: GET /resources.

cursor_next.description: The cursorNext from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

cursor_prev.description: The cursorPrev from a page, to go one page back.

type.description: One or more resource types. System types: meeting_room (bookable meeting rooms), hotdesk (bookable hot desks), team_room (private offices), desk (dedicated desks), desk_tr (desks inside private offices), desk_na (not available); orgs may add custom types.

name: officernd_list_resources
title: List resources
